svg.text: OBI subordinate window, 4 KB, 32-bit words. Offsets 0x064 and above are unmapped and answer with r.err.

rect.title: MAGIC (RO): Constant 0x434F5244
MAJOR (RO): Major version
MINOR (RO): Minor version
PATCH (RO): Patch version
DATA_WIDTH (RO): Fixed-point word width in bits
FRAC_BITS (RO): Fractional bits of the fixed-point word
NUM_STAGES (RO): CORDIC micro-rotations per operation
GUARD_INT (RO): Integer guard bits of the internal datapath
GUARD_FRAC (RO): Fractional guard bits of the internal datapath
VARIANT (RO): 0 = fully pipelined, 1 = iterative
USE_RREADY (RO): 1 if the OBI R channel implements rready
IN_DEPTH (RO): Input FIFO depth in entries
OUT_DEPTH (RO): Output FIFO depth in entries
LATENCY (RO): Issue-to-result latency in clock cycles
INTERVAL (RO): Minimum cycles between accepted operations
SOFT_RST (W1S): Abort every operation in flight, flush both FIFOs, clear the sticky errors and the IRQ state. Operand, CMD and SCRATCH registers are left alone
POP (W1S): Discard the result at the head of the output FIFO
FLUSH_IN (W1S): Drop every queued but unstarted operation
FLUSH_OUT (W1S): Drop every completed but unread result
CLR_ERR (W1S): Clear the sticky STATUS.ERR_* bits
IRQ_EN_DONE (RW): Route IRQ.DONE to the interrupt output
IRQ_EN_ERR (RW): Route IRQ.ERR to the interrupt output
BUSY (RO): Operations are queued or in flight
RES_VALID (RO): At least one result is readable
IN_FULL (RO): Input FIFO cannot accept another operation
IN_EMPTY (RO): Input FIFO holds no operation
OUT_FULL (RO): Output FIFO cannot accept another result
OUT_EMPTY (RO): Output FIFO holds no result
IN_COUNT (RO): Operations queued in the input FIFO
OUT_COUNT (RO): Results waiting in the output FIFO
ERR_DOMAIN (RO): Sticky: an operand was outside the convergence domain
ERR_OVERFLOW (RO): Sticky: an issue was dropped, input FIFO was full
ERR_UNDERFLOW (RO): Sticky: a result was read or popped while empty
ERR_ACCESS (RO): Sticky: an unmapped, unaligned or illegal access occurred
DONE (W1C): A result was pushed into the output FIFO
ERR (W1C): One of the sticky STATUS.ERR_* bits was set
VALUE (RW): Signed fixed-point operand X
VALUE (RW): Signed fixed-point operand Y
VALUE (RW): Signed fixed-point operand Z
FUNC (RW): Function code, see the function table
TAG (RW): Free-form tag returned in RES_FLAGS.TAG
GO (W1S): Queue an operation from OP_X, OP_Y, OP_Z and FUNC
VALUE (RO): Signed fixed-point result X
VALUE (RO): Signed fixed-point result Y
VALUE (RO): Signed fixed-point result Z
DOMAIN_ERR (RO): Operand outside the convergence domain, X/Y/Z forced to 0
SAT_X (RO): Result X saturated to the format limit
SAT_Y (RO): Result Y saturated to the format limit
SAT_Z (RO): Result Z saturated to the format limit
FUNC (RO): Function code of this result
TAG (RO): Tag supplied in CMD.TAG
VALUE (RO): prod sqrt(1 + 2**-2s) over the elaborated stages
VALUE (RO): 1 / K_CIRC
VALUE (RO): prod sqrt(1 - 2**-2s) over the elaborated stages
VALUE (RO): 1 / K_HYP
VALUE (RO): sum atan(2**-s) in radians
VALUE (RO): sum atanh(2**-s)
VALUE (RO): sum 2**-s
VALUE (RO): tanh(LIM_HYP)
VALUE (RW): Free for software; also the byte-enable test target

svg.text: Unlabelled cells are reserved: writes are ignored and reads return 0. W1S bits self-clear and always read 0.
Operand and result words hold signed fixed-point values in the elaborated format reported by CFG0.
